notes: Packet has no full text; F1 (reaction scheme) and F2 (molecules) are uncaptioned schematics, F3-F7 are paper Figs 1-5. Branches after cycling: reduction (n9) -> low-voltage plateau -> low thermal reactivity -> safety; reversibility (n10) -> reversible capacity -> cycling. Figure-vs-text discrepancies: F4 (paper Fig. 2) y-axis labelled capacity but shows potential; F5c peak positions (20.2/30.8 deg) differ from text (22/32 deg); F6c as-made muconate is sharply crystalline and recharged regains reflections (text: poorly crystallized, remains amorphous); F6b linked text says charged and discharged IR superimpose, figure shows discharged differs; F5d recharged phthalate keeps a residual EPR line. Panel caption spans for F5b/F6b ('in situ XRD') and F5c/F6c ('EPR') are shifted by one panel.
